import pathlib, hashlib, json, subprocess, difflib
root = pathlib.Path('.')
def scan():
    return {p.as_posix(): p.read_bytes() for p in sorted((root / 'src').rglob('*.txt')) if p.is_file()}
def digest(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
original = scan()
assert original, 'No source text files found'
baseline = {p: {'sha256': digest(b), 'text': b.decode('utf-8')} for p,b in original.items()}
bp = root / 'baseline.json'
assert not bp.exists(), 'baseline.json already exists; refusing to overwrite'
base_bytes = (json.dumps(baseline, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n').encode('utf-8')
with bp.open('xb') as f:
    f.write(base_bytes)
assert bp.read_bytes() == base_bytes
mutation = subprocess.run(['fs-fixture-advance'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if mutation.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError(f'fs-fixture-advance failed ({mutation.returncode}): stdout={mutation.stdout"'!r} stderr={mutation.stderr!r}'"')
def compare():
    loaded_bytes = bp.read_bytes()
    assert loaded_bytes == base_bytes, 'Baseline bytes changed'
    loaded = json.loads(loaded_bytes)
    current = scan()
    hashes = {p: digest(b) for p,b in current.items()}
    added = sorted(set(current) - set(loaded))
    deleted = sorted(set(loaded) - set(current))
    modified = sorted(p for p in set(current) & set(loaded) if hashes[p] "'!= loaded[p]['"'sha256'])
    changed_lines = []
    for p in modified:
        before = loaded[p]['text'].splitlines(keepends=True)
        after = current[p].decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True)
        for tag, i, j, k, l in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, before, after, autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
            if tag in ('replace', 'insert'):
                for n in range(k,l):
                    line = after[n]
                    if line.endswith('\\r\\n'):
                        line = line[:-2]
                    elif line.endswith(('\\n','\\r')):
                        line = line[:-1]
                    changed_lines.append({'path':p, 'line':n+1, 'text':line})
    report = {'added':added, 'modified':modified, 'deleted':deleted, 'unchanged':len(set(current) & set(loaded))-len(modified), 'changed_lines':changed_lines}
    return report, hashes
first, hashes1 = compare()
second, hashes2 = compare()
consistent = first == second and hashes1 == hashes2
assert consistent, 'Fresh comparisons were inconsistent'
preserved = bp.read_bytes() == base_bytes
assert preserved, 'Baseline bytes changed after verification'
first.update(repeat_consistent=consistent, baseline_preserved=preserved)
print(json.dumps(first, ensure_ascii=False))
